are-anti-defense-modules-enriched-in-hum.reason: Deciding this needs anti-defense gene calls per genome, which the lakehouse's defense and mobilome tables lack, so they must come from public genome protein annotations.

are-conserved-core-proteins-with-shallow.reason: Whether shallow-alignment core clusters sit within one lineage is decided by computing clade and phylum reach across pangenome clusters in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

are-essential-genes-outside-the-core-gen.reason: Whether essential genes have same-function core paralogs in genomes lacking them decides it; needs gene-to-cluster and Fitness Browser-to-pangenome links in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

are-fungal-lignin-enrichment-communities.reason: Only new replicated lignin enrichments with deep fungal sequencing and a mock community can decide whether early colonisers drive the divergence.

are-gapfilled-reactions-without-enzyme-n.reason: Fitness-linked candidate genes must first be narrowed with lakehouse reaction and annotation data, then purified-enzyme assays on predicted substrates decide the hypothesis.

are-lab-latent-metabolic-pathways-the-on.reason: Per-genome pathway calls across conspecific genomes and per-gene fitness values can decide whether latent pathways vary more within species.

are-large-bacterial-genomes-rich-in-prop.reason: Core, accessory and singleton status of prophage-annotated clusters, linked to genome size, can decide it in the KBase Data Lakehouse; dedicated prophage calls are a secondary check.

are-metal-resistance-hotspots-in-environ.reason: Whether ore and rock distances or industrial release distances better predict hotspot genomes decides it; the KBase Data Lakehouse catalogs the inputs.

are-metal-specific-fitness-genes-accesso.reason: Whether metal-specific fitness genes sit in accessory clusters more often in metal-impacted genomes needs lakehouse fitness, pangenome and isolation-source tables joined.

are-sulfate-reducers-rare-in-groundwater.reason: Only matched sediment and groundwater from the same wells, measured by gene-targeted quantification, can decide whether marker genes are concentrated in sediment.

do-accessory-fitness-modules-move-betwee.reason: Whether accessory modules sit close on chromosomes and co-occur across genomes is decided by lakehouse gene coordinates and pangenome cluster tables, plus project module lists.

do-accessory-genes-look-condition-neutra.reason: The lakehouse fitness experiments, SEED annotations, specific-phenotype calls and pangenome core flags decide it, once genes are joined to clusters.

do-aromatic-and-non-aromatic-catabolic-c.reason: Co-occurrence of capacities needs lakehouse genome data first, but growth of isolates on mixed carbon sources needs new lab measurements to decide.

do-bioleaching-bacteria-carry-different-.reason: Testing each metal-handling family against size-matched background species needs annotated gene clusters from the KBase Data Lakehouse.

do-catalase-negative-bacteria-use-other-.reason: The hypothesis is decided by counting alternative oxidative-defence genes and comparing catalase-negative with catalase-positive strains, which the lakehouse tables can support; a new analysis may be needed.

do-commensal-mixtures-suppress-pseudomon.reason: Deciding this needs new co-culture measurements of PA14 and an ExoS-type strain with commensal mixtures; the KBase Data Lakehouse catalog did not show such data.

do-conserved-motility-genes-that-cost-gr.reason: Soft-agar fitness of costly motility genes can be checked in lakehouse data; a soil or plant-root test needs new measurements.

do-conserved-resistance-genes-persist-be.reason: Whether core resistance genes carry more non-antibiotic condition phenotypes is decided by lakehouse fitness and pangenome tables, once gene links are rebuilt.

do-conserved-unannotated-genes-keep-thei.reason: Whether condition classes match across phyla decides the hypothesis; the Fitness Browser ortholog, phenotype, condition-group and gene tables supply the pairs and classes.

do-core-and-accessory-copies-of-plant-gr.reason: Whether accessory and core plant-growth gene copies sit near mobile elements decides it, needing gene positions joined to element coordinates in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

do-cystic-fibrosis-lung-pseudomonas-aeru.reason: The growth half needs assays on matched lung and environmental isolates; repeated pathway losses can be traced from KBase Data Lakehouse pangenome tables first.

do-deep-clay-bacillota-b-genomes-grow-la.reason: The hypothesis is decided by genome sizes and gene functions of Bacillota_B genomes from deep-subsurface and soil isolates, compared within genera, already in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

do-freshwater-biofilm-comamonadaceae-iso.reason: Isolate depletion and isotope labelling need new lab measurements; a lakehouse analysis first narrows which compounds the experiment tests.

do-groundwater-iron-oxidisers-persist-in.reason: Lakehouse sample and abundance records can pick the well, but only new paired microcosms can show whether iron oxidisers stay in water while Anaeromyxobacter and Methanoperedens stay on solids.

do-gut-communities-form-a-continuous-gra.reason: The hypothesis turns on candidate abundance and disease across cohorts, which needs a multi-cohort species abundance matrix the lakehouse catalog did not show.

do-gut-enterobacteriaceae-carry-extra-si.reason: Within-genus isolation source and siderophore/genotoxin cluster content of Enterobacteriaceae genomes decide it; KBase Data Lakehouse pangenome and metagenome tables hold both.

do-resistance-genes-share-neighbors-with.reason: Gene-level fitness under surface and liquid conditions, and random-gene controls, are not shown in the catalog; they may need public fitness data or a new soft-agar experiment.

do-restriction-modification-and-gabija-d.reason: Phage-challenge assays of each system alone and together decide layered protection and need new strains; lakehouse genome data first narrows which pairings to test.

do-soil-bacteria-with-the-auxin-gene-ipd.reason: Genome-matched pathway and annotation analysis in the KBase Data Lakehouse narrows which ipdC carriers to test; defined-medium growth and auxin measurements require new experiments.

do-soil-microbes-lose-amino-acid-synthes.reason: Only an amendment experiment with sequencing can decide it; lakehouse analysis first narrows which soils and amino acids to test.

do-species-from-diverse-environments-gai.reason: Whether mobile-element flanking of resistance genes rises with environmental diversity needs gene neighbour and environment joins from the KBase Data Lakehouse.

do-species-with-more-metabolic-ecotypes-.reason: Pathway presence and genome-to-species links in the KBase Data Lakehouse decide whether ecotype counts follow breadth within families; embedding join unverified.

do-the-unannotated-genes-of-methanococcu.reason: Co-fitness partners of the dark Methanococcus genes decide it; the KBase Data Lakehouse fitness tables and uniref50 cluster lookups supply both inputs.

do-transposon-insertions-miss-essential-.reason: Whether truncated genes keep function is decided only by building truncation alleles and testing growth; the lakehouse catalog does not show ADP1 insertion positions.

do-truly-dark-genes-with-nutrient-phenot.reason: Whether substrate-matched partners of dark nutrient genes outnumber those of annotation-lag genes needs co-fitness and annotation tables already in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

do-xoxf-carriers-without-their-own-pqq-s.reason: Whether PQQ-lacking xoxF carriers sit with PQQ producers is first checked in lakehouse MAG samples; spent-medium growth needs a new lab test.

does-anaerostipes-caccae-get-its-lactate.reason: Only a new co-culture experiment in defined lactate-limited medium can decide whether partner strains supply lactate; the catalog did not show paired growth or butyrate data.

does-complex-i-matter-on-quinate-because.reason: Deciding whether Complex I essentiality follows NADH production rate needs growth and NADH ratio measurements under controlled quinate supply, which only a new lab experiment provides.

does-conjugative-element-load-more-than-.reason: Counting each mobile-element type and distinct resistance genes per genome in the lakehouse decides it; genome and biome identifiers allow joining.

does-desulfovibrio-vulgaris-make-serine-.reason: Only labeled-glycine tracing and serine-free growth can decide the route; lakehouse fitness tables can first list candidate genes.

does-iron-and-zinc-cross-resistance-run-.reason: Fitness scores across iron and zinc experiments in the KBase Data Lakehouse can decide whether iron-sulfur genes drive shared sensitivity.

does-long-term-warming-remove-labile-com.reason: Whether lost metabolites fall in labile classes needs compound-class assignments for identifiers, which must come from outside reference data.

does-measured-soil-acidity-predict-acces.reason: Pangenome gene content and measured soil pH from the lakehouse can decide the hypothesis, if enough species have usable pH.

does-photosystem-ii-exchange-signal-vani.reason: The hypothesis is decided by photosystem II gene presence and photic-aquatic habitat labels across genera, which the lakehouse annotation and genome tables can supply.

does-plant-derived-carbon-input-not-ecos.reason: Whether plant-derived carbon or ecosystem label sets pathway completeness is decided by joining lakehouse metabolomics, taxonomy and sample metadata.

does-removing-core-pathobionts-shift-cro.reason: Whether removing pathobionts shifts Crohn's cultures toward non-IBD metabolite profiles needs new anaerobic removal experiments with metabolomics; the KBase Data Lakehouse catalog cannot decide it.

does-soil-acidity-which-frees-lanthanide.reason: The hypothesis is decided by soil pH and xoxF presence per genome, which the lakehouse genome, gene, annotation and biosample tables can link.

does-urea-use-in-acinetobacter-depend-on.reason: Whether non-urease genes drive urea-specific growth needs the ADP1 mutant growth matrix, which the catalog did not show; pangenome conservation and BacDive urea calls then compare.

does-warming-raise-methane-oxidation-tra.reason: The hypothesis needs paired gene-level DNA and RNA abundances from these warming samples and other warming studies, which the KBase Data Lakehouse catalog did not show.

is-acidity-rather-than-temperature-what-.reason: Acidity versus temperature is decided by culture growth across pH and temperature, which needs new measurements after a lakehouse survey analysis.

is-acquired-resistance-spread-by-repeate.reason: Ancestral gain counts for resistance and non-resistance accessory gene clusters, from species trees and gene-cluster membership in the KBase Data Lakehouse, decide it.

is-crohn-s-linked-e-coli-a-siderophore-a.reason: Whether cluster-positive carriers differ from cluster-negative ones needs patient-matched genotyping of isolates or stool, which the lakehouse catalog did not show.

is-lanmodulin-an-ancient-methylotroph-li.reason: Lanthanide handling after lanmodulin deletion needs a lab experiment; annotation and cluster tables may first help identify xoxF-lacking carriers, but gene positions are unshown.

is-metal-and-antibiotic-tolerance-unpred.reason: Only new graded-dose growth assays on sequenced strains, with copy-number and promoter-variant calls, can decide whether these features beat presence-only prediction.

is-smooth-module-free-gene-importance-an.reason: Deciding the hypothesis needs new barcoded ADP1 mutant measurements; a lakehouse analysis of carbon-source experiment metadata first narrows the matched comparison.

is-the-cost-of-dispensable-genes-carried.reason: The whole-element versus single-gene growth comparison needs new deletion measurements, after lakehouse gene coordinates and fitness narrow which islands to test.

is-the-link-between-polyhydroxybutyrate-.reason: Carrier and non-carrier genomes within shared genera in the KBase Data Lakehouse hold the annotations, habitat coordinates and genome size needed to decide the hypothesis.

is-the-shared-metal-and-salt-gene-set-an.reason: The hypothesis is decided by fitness scores across organisms under sodium, potassium, choline and non-ionic osmolyte experiments, which the Fitness Browser tables can supply.

is-the-snipe-phage-defense-nuclease-tied.reason: Only building manYZ deletion mutants in a SNIPE-carrying strain can decide the causal effect; lakehouse analyses first pick the strain.

is-xoxf-in-non-methylotrophs-a-methanol-.reason: Growth tests on methanol and other alcohols, with and without lanthanum, in carrier isolates decide it; lakehouse pathway annotations of xoxF carriers choose which to test.

might-buffered-respiratory-genes-not-sph.reason: Only new strain construction, viability scoring and lipidomics under low oxygen and iron limitation can decide whether the operon is required.
